basic_info.description: Experience the best of urban living in this stunning SOMA townhouse that offers the space and privacy of a single-family home. Nestled in one of SF's most vibrant neighborhoods, this unique residence features a private garage with EV, a backyard, and an ideal layout perfect for modern lifestyles. Step into the main level, where an open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area is bathed in natural light, highlighted by soaring double-height ceilings. The sleek kitchen boasts Pietra Grey countertops, rich dark wood cabinetry, and premium appliances, making it a chef's dream. At the rear, the primary bedroom provides a serene retreat, complemented by a modern full bath with Paperstone countertops. Ascend to the upper-level enclosed loft bedroom, where expansive windows flood the space with light, creating a bright and airy ambiance. On the ground floor, behind the garage, a fully equipped studio apartment with its own kitchen and full bath offers endless possibilities, ideal for guests, a home office, or rental income. The studio opens directly to the private backyard, a rare find in the heart of the city. Located in the dynamic SOMA district, this home places you moments from top dining, nightlife, and transit, blending style, function, and flexibility in one exceptional package.
